With the backflow function it incorporates a mechanism to exhaust the air pressure in the outlet side reliably and quickly.
BULLET POINTS: Modular type filter regulator. Transparent bowl guard. Available with built-in backflow mechanism. Rc, G(PF) or NPT threads.

DESCRIPTION: ISE30A, 2 Colour Display High-Precision Digital Pressure Switch for Positive Pressure
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Output Specification: F (PNP open collector 1 output + Analogue current output) Option 1: G (Lead Wire w/Connector (Lead Wire Length 2m) and with connector cover) Option 2: None Port Size: 01 (R 1/8 (w/M5 Female)) Unit: With unit display switching function Option 3: Booklet Made to Order: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: Based on our successful ZSE/ISE 30 Series, our new high precision digital pressure switch, Series ZSE30 A(F) / ISE30A, with dual colour display, offers even more high performance features. Now available with either NPN or PNP dual open collector outputs, or with the addition of an additional analogue output (voltage or current), the sensors improved copy function also allows you to simultaneously set up to 10 slave monitors whilst setting the master. With a simple to follow three step setting process and the addition of a password setting function, potential errors, lengthy setting time and unwanted manipulation are kept to an absolute minimum. Further features of the CE, UL/CSA and RoHS compliant ZSE30 A(F) / ISE30A include a power saving function, which reduces energy consumption by up to 20%, various piping options and direct or panel mounting capabilities.
BULLET POINTS: Copy function available. More output options than in previous ZSE/ISE30 Series. Possible to check set-value during key locking. Pin code function available. Space savings. 3-step setting. 4-digit display. Replaceable one-touch fittings. Additional functions.
